answer: The toy shop's archive keeps the proof long after the epoch closes, so a forgery has nowhere quiet to age. One proof settles it, and it reads Hemmer silk gown mark sewn into the tailor's shop, spelled out in full as each silk gown is a year of sewing logs in the cloth ledger. The terrace says who, the timber says how much, the basalt says how long — and of the three, the farm fears the last answer most. An honest proof costs 220 POA; the farm pays the same per proof but needs 689 of them, which totals 151580 POA.
